name: net_lod_morale
description: VUH-2342: two local instances on the player defaults. The host warps to Bamboo Grove 08/01 programs 68 (mission MU01_MS102, the first morale fight), both dismiss the morale tutorial and fight. Both games' mission objects are sampled every second: the friend's MORALE gauge must show the host's value (within 1.0 in 90% of samples), and when the host's mission ends the friend's ends too, with neither failed. Clips film both HUDs.

steps.expr: all((bridge(i).get('puppet0') or {}).get('active') for i in range(2))
log_count('[mission-mirror] client ready',1)==1 and log_count('[mission-mirror] client follow',1)>=1

steps.name: 1 Morale fight MU01_MS102: the friend shows the host's gauge

steps.expr: [[round(p[0]['gauges'][0]['value'],2), round(p[1]['gauges'][0]['value'],2)] for p in [s['value'] for s in saved['fight1_samples'] if 'value' in s and s['value'][0] and s['value'][1] and s['value'][0]['file']==s['value'][1]['file'] and not (s['value'][1]['flags'] & 0x14)]]

steps.message: too few samples with the same mission on both games

steps.expr: sum(1 for h,f in saved['fight1_samples_pairs'] if abs(h-f)<=1.0)>=0.9*len(saved['fight1_samples_pairs'])
steps.message: the friend's gauge did not follow the host's (more than 10% of samples off by over 1.0)

steps.name: 2 The mission ends the same way on both

steps.expr: not (saved['mission_end'][0] and saved['mission_end'][0]['result']==2) and not (saved['mission_end'][1] and saved['mission_end'][1]['result']==2)
steps.message: a mission failed during the success run
the friend's mission did not end with the host's

steps.expr: [log_count('[mission-mirror] host frame',0), log_count('[mission-mirror] client sec following=1',1), log_count('[mission-mirror] client-refused',1), log_count('[mission-mirror] host end trap',0), log_count('[mission-mirror] client end like the host',1)]

steps.message: the mission mirror refused a pin on the friend
the host's end was not replayed on the friend
